title: Do LLMs Know What Is Private Internally? Probing and Steering Contextual Privacy Norms in Large Language Model Representations
reasoning: The paper studies Large Language Models' adherence to contextual privacy norms based on the Contextual Integrity (CI) theory, a normative ethical framework. It benchmarks models on their ability to determine the appropriateness of information flow, which is a form of moral and normative judgment regarding social values.
